briefing:
Fugitive tech, stolen habitat firmware, and a price tag with extra zeroes. Bring them in or bring proof they stopped breathing. Court prefers the first option.

Legal pinged us twice. That is how you know it is messy.

beats.insert: CHATTER // Port gossip on open band: 'they are still aboard.' Your warrant disagrees politely. Deck plates ring hollow underfoot.
beats.complication: TRAIL // Booby-wired locker and a fake ID chip. They knew someone would come. Maybe they wanted someone specific.
beats.crisis: SIGNATURE // Elite nest heat bloom on Deck 9. Either the fugitive brought pets, or they became one. Warrant does not care which.

debrief.win: Target neutralized or cuffed in spirit if not in body. Legal sends a form that counts as applause. Credits hit before the ink dries.
debrief.partial: Nest cleared but no positive ID. Bounty office pays a nuisance fee. You are on the watch list politely.
debrief.fail: Target ghosts. Legal heat on the crew. Nav deletes the route from the log. Pretends it was never there.
